default_initial_description:
Initial cleaning for a {{Square Footage}}sqft home.

Before beginning your recurring cleaning service, our team will perform a comprehensive Initial Cleaning. This one-time deep clean ensures that every area of your home is refreshed and prepared for regular maintenance. During this service, we’ll give extra attention to high-traffic and hard-to-reach areas, providing a spotless foundation to keep your home looking its best with ongoing care.

Kitchen:
• Wipe down countertops, appliance exteriors, and cabinets.
• Clean range hood.
• Clean inside microwave.
• Vacuum and mop floors.
• Empty trash.

Bathrooms:
• Clean sinks, counters, and mirrors.
• Scrub showers, bathtubs, and toilets.
• Wipe cabinet fronts and mop floors.
• Vacuum & mop floors.

Living Room & Common Areas:
• Dust all surfaces, including furniture.
• Clean and sanitize high-touch areas (light switches, doorknobs).
• Vacuum carpets and rugs; mop hard floors.

Bedrooms:
• Dust surfaces, including nightstands.
• Change bed linens (if new linens are provided).
• Vacuum carpets and mop hard floors as applicable.

Everywhere else:
• Cobweb dusting.
• High dusting fans & light fixtures.
• Baseboards.
• Blinds/Shutters.
• Window Sills.

This is not a comprehensive list of all areas that are cleaned, however this should give an idea of what is included in the service. If home is extremely dirty, final price is subject to change.
